journeys.description: The restaurant in Singapore charged me SGD 20 extra and refuses to refund it.

question.prompt: Was this for personal or business use?
question.reason: Consumer assistance may depend on the purpose of the purchase.

question.prompt: Are you seeking help as a local consumer or a visitor?
question.reason: The reviewed complaint-contact profile distinguishes its service audience.

context.summary: You reported a restaurant billing overcharge. You want to seek repayment.

canonical.message: A reviewed preparation or assistance step is available. This does not establish eligibility or guarantee an outcome.

assessment.text: CASE has an assistance route for personal consumer disputes. Ask it to assess the reported charge and its scope.

checklist.text: Keep the receipt, advertised price and your written exchanges.
Note the price or charge you dispute and the correction you requested.

contacts.note: Monday to Friday, 9 am to 5 pm, excluding public holidays.
Use this for assistance enquiries. The online form is the complaint submission channel.

items.text: A potentially misleading representation is a point to raise. Whether the facts meet the legal test needs assessment.
Check whether the seller and personal purchase fit the published CASE scope.
Ask which service is offered and whether that service has fees or membership requirements.
Ask CASE for advice before deciding whether to use another procedure.

journeys.description: My work pass was cancelled and I must leave my private condo early. My landlord will not refund my rental deposit.

question.prompt: Have you already ended the tenancy?
question.reason: The immediate step differs for a planned exit and a completed exit.

question.prompt: Does your signed lease include a break or diplomatic clause?

assessment.text: Review the lease terms and the circumstances of the exit before assessing a deposit deduction.

checklist.text: Keep the signed terms, written notice, relevant pass or employment notice and proof of delivery.
Ask the landlord for the written reason and itemised deduction. Keep your deposit record.

items.text: The private rental template illustrates optional terms. Check the clauses and choices in the agreement you actually signed.
